label: Under-five mortality
definition: Under-five mortality rate is the probability per 1,000 that a newborn baby will die before reaching age five, if subject to age-specific mortality rates of the specified year.

denominator.label: live births
denominator.definition: Probability per 1,000 live births, not total population.

method: Latest non-null producer value in the explicitly fixed 2020–2025 window.

legacyCountry.label: Under-five mortality
legacyCountry.note: A population rate, not the number of children who died.
